title: mol-latex-concat plan.json
description: The agent<->script contract for the mol-latex-concat formula. The inspect step seeds it; every later helper READS and EXTENDS it; write_report.py renders REPORT.md from it. One file on disk, shared across the formula's single session. Helpers are testable in isolation: feed a plan.json + sources, assert the extended plan.json. Objects are deliberately open (additionalProperties:true) so a downstream helper may add fields without a schema bump; only the load-bearing keys are required.

schema_version.description: Schema contract version. Bump on a breaking shape change.

vars.description: The formula vars as resolved for this run (echoed so helpers and the report are self-contained).

sources.description: Ordered list of source document directories. Order == chapter order.

dest.description: Destination project dir. Empty string => a fresh blank merged-latex/ is created.

tex_engine.description: TeX engine for the compile gate.

dest.description: The destination project, as decided by the scaffold step.

mode.description: blank => freshly created report-class merged-latex/; existing => merge into an established project, respecting its class/preamble.

dir.description: Absolute or run-relative path to the destination project root.

document_class.description: The destination master document class (e.g. report, ucsddissertation).

master_tex.description: Master .tex filename relative to dest.dir (default main.tex).

master_bib.description: Merged bibliography filename the master cites.

chapter_input_idiom.description: How a chapter is wired into the master (e.g. "\input{contents/<slug>/main}"); for an existing template, mirror its established idiom.

sources.description: Per-source inventory, index-aligned with vars.sources (chapter order). Seeded by inspect_sources.py; extended in place by the transform / verify steps.

dir.description: Source directory as given in vars.sources.

slug.description: Short unique lowercase abbreviation (e.g. ahks, ptw, pid). Namespaces renamed macros, prefixed labels, the chapter dir.

title.description: From the source \title{...}; becomes the \chapter{} title (unless overridden in wire-main).

title_override.description: Human/agent override for the chapter title when the inferred \title is unsuitable.

tex_engine.description: Per-source engine hint (e.g. fontspec => xelatex/lualatex). The run-wide var wins for the merged compile; a mismatch is a flag.

macros.description: Every macro-defining command in the preamble.

kind.description: newcommand | renewcommand | providecommand | DeclareMathOperator | newtheorem | def | let | ...

body.description: Definition body, used to decide identical-vs-divergent collisions.

labels.description: Every \label key defined in this source.

local_sty.description: Local style files shipped beside the source (e.g. quiver.sty).

authors.description: \author entries; >1 => a flagged coauthorship chapter footnote.

baseline_compiled.description: Set by verify.py --baseline: did this source compile standalone? null until checked.

transformed.description: Set by the transform step once mirrored+stripped into the dest.

chapter_main.description: Destination path of the stripped chapter body, e.g. contents/<slug>/main.tex.

from_slugs.description: Which sources requested it (provenance for the report).

reason.description: e.g. class-owned by dest, geometry/font/margin conflict.

renames.description: Every namespacing rewrite, for the report and for re-derivation. Written by resolve_macros.py, prefix_labels.py, merge_bib.py.

macros.description: Divergent-collision macro renames (earlier chapter keeps the bare name; later gets a slug suffix).

labels.description: Proactive per-chapter \label slug-prefixing (and the matching ref-family rewrites).

bib_keys.description: same-key-different-work bib renames (later paper's key gets a slug suffix; \cite uses rewritten).

bib.description: Bibliography merge log, written by merge_bib.py.

merged_bib.description: Path of the single merged .bib in the dest.

duplicates_collapsed.description: Exact-duplicate entries (same key, same work) folded to one.

flags.description: The Tier-2 'flag-and-defer, never guess' channel. A helper that meets a construct it cannot soundly transform appends a flag here instead of guessing; the agent (Tier 3) resolves each and fills `resolution`. write_report.py surfaces every flag in REPORT.md. The compile gate is the backstop for anything a helper missed.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. F1, F2 (so resolutions can reference it).

tier.description: Tier of the construct that triggered the flag (usually 2).

severity.description: blocker => must be resolved before the compile gate can pass.

stage.description: Which step raised it: inspect | baseline | scaffold | transform | hoist | resolve | merge-bib | wire | verify.

slug.description: Source slug it concerns, or null for cross-source flags (e.g. an option conflict).

kind.description: Machine tag, e.g. exotic-class | multiple-entry-files | option-conflict | custom-ref-macro | same-key-different-work | engine-mismatch | exotic-bst.

message.description: Human-readable description of what was deferred and why.

location.description: file:line or file the flag points at.

resolution.description: Filled by the agent (Tier 3): what it decided/did. null == unresolved.

log.description: Append-only step log; the spine of REPORT.md.
